title: Correct empirical formula
description: Essential: The response must state or correctly apply the empirical relationship F = (3m - 1.5) N, where m is the number of parts.

title: Force for 32 parts
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (1) must be 94.5 N (or equivalent).

title: Friction coefficient value
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for part (2) must be 0.3 (or equivalent).

title: Force analysis for m=2
description: Important: The solution must correctly identify and use the data point for m=2 (F=4.5 N) to solve for the friction coefficient.

title: Normal force calculation
description: Important: The reasoning must correctly account for the normal forces on each sliding interface when the books are interleaved (e.g., for m=2, weights of G/2, G, and G+G/2).

title: Friction force summation
description: Important: The solution must sum the kinetic friction forces from all sliding interfaces to equate to the applied force F.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: All forces should be expressed with correct units (Newtons) throughout the calculation.

title: Incorrect normal force
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the normal force on any interface is miscalculated (e.g., using full book weight for all interfaces).

title: Misapplied empirical formula
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the empirical formula F = (3m - 1.5) is misapplied (e.g., incorrect arithmetic for m=32).
